summary: Distinguish missing network seeds from controller failures
details: Healthy core services now complete startup successfully while awaiting a seed, returning outcome awaiting_seed without claiming network readiness. Repeated up does not restart the controller, and interactive up continues watching.

Status and watch use fresh chain membership observations to show WAITING_FOR_SEED with peers add and peers status actions. Historical exit-2 results remain available in detailed output and JSON, while genuine controller failures and unavailable observations retain their diagnostics.

The monitor preserves controller outcome fields and no longer raises CONTROLLER_FAILED for confirmed historical manual exits when the node is ready or waiting for a seed. Status queries do not clear systemd records or alter services.
